title: Compute cart totals and add the revenue report query
description: Adds the shared cart-total helper used by checkout and the weekly revenue/active-customer query the finance dashboard renders.

expected.note: Money is summed and discounted with binary floating-point numbers, so totals drift (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3) and the displayed amount can disagree with what is charged. Work in integer cents (or a decimal type) and convert only for display.
`COUNT(user_id)` counts invoice rows, not distinct customers, so a user with several paid invoices is counted multiple times and `active_customers` is inflated. Use `COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)`.
